text:
dan_arch: quick RFC follow-up: propose a 'locality boundary' per-region to own ephemeral egress leases + src-ip affinity. CP stays global/canonical. Goal: reduce hairpin, make egress accounting local.

anya_s: sketch pls? how's this distinct from relay/peering we've debated?

dan_arch: tiny ascii:
```
global-cp
  |
  +-- locality-us-east -> egress-pool-us-east (ENI/NAT or privatelink)
  +-- locality-eu-west -> egress-pool-eu-west
```
locality = thin process: lease manager, minimal certs, health + metrics. does NOT host model runtime.

kevin_p: security: boundary holding certs seems risky. rotation + KMS plan?

dan_arch: bounded keys only, KMS-wrapped, CP issues signed lease tokens with TTL (default 10m). renewals required. include nonce anti-replay in token.

sara_ops: for private-only tenants (no public egress), boundary should map to private endpoint instead of NAT, right?

dan_arch: right. same operator surface; backend differs. simplifies rollout for mixed customers.

anya_s: failure semantics on CP partition? fail-soft or fail-closed?

dan_arch: fail-soft: existing leases remain until TTL expiry; new leases blocked. mark region degraded in console, surface alerts.

infra-bot: checklist generated: [boundary image], [lease-proto v1], [metrics export], [private mapping], [cutover playbook].

kevin_p: ops concern: more pieces to monitor. need central logs + region-indexed metrics.

dan_arch: agreed. boundaries push lease events and health to CP logs; auto-remediation playbooks (restart, tombstone IPs).

sara_ops: rollout: feature-flag per-tenant. start with low-traffic dev tenants in one region for 2w. monitor p95, egress bill, NAT exhaustion.

anya_s: add tests for route-flap during lease renewal (no mid-conn src-ip flip).

dan_arch: will add appendix: lease token format, TTLs, health signals, rollout gates. action items: dan update appendix EOD Thu; anya write tests Mon; kevin security checklist Tue; sara rollout playbook Fri.

kevin_p: naming note: use 'locality boundary' in docs to avoid product confusion.

dan_arch: ACK. I'll push the draft to RFC repo and ping arch-review.
